ocf_qoq.availability: max publication availability of all dependency versions; never period_end
ocf_qoq.historical_availability: SEC structured reporting generally from 2009; tag/issuer coverage varies
ocf_qoq.normalization: raw accounting ratio/change first; PIT sector percentile or train-only standardization for models
ocf_qoq.missing_rule: None for absent inputs, mismatched currency/duration, or invalid denominator; no zero imputation
ocf_qoq.validation: deterministic arithmetic/PIT fixtures; purged 1/5/20/60/120-session IC and cost-aware temporal ablation when coverage exists
ocf_qoq.evidence: Earnings/fundamental momentum hypothesis; growth alone is not a priced edge; local IC and ablation required
